sources.sm_surface: NASA SMAP L4 SPL4SMGP v007 via Google Earth Engine (NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007), band sm_surface, 0-5 cm, m3/m3, ~9 km, model that assimilates SMAP observations; monthly mean of 3-hourly values over the center bbox

method: State = tercile rank of the month among the same calendar month in other years, per center and per source. Unit-free.
level_rule: strong: Bonferroni-adjusted p<0.01 AND agreement>=50% (the 50% is a design choice, not a statistical standard); moderate: adjusted p<0.05; else weak. Adjusted p = p x 3 centers.
caveats: agreement p-values are approximate: neighbouring months are not independent
~10-11 values per calendar month, so each tercile has 3-4 values
SMAP L4 is a model + satellite product, not a direct measurement; instrument outages 2019-06-19..07-23 and 2022-08-06..09-20 are model-only
